    Run cell-phase rho summary

    run_phase_rho.Rd

    This function summarizes the circular concentration of inferred cell phases within each cell type and group. If a sample-level column is provided, rho is also summarized at the cell type, group, and sample level, and pairwise group comparisons are performed within each cell type.

    run_phase_rho(
  res_phase,
  metadata,
  celltype_by = "celltype",
  group_by = "condition",
  sample_by = NULL,
  theta_by = "theta_pred",
  celltype_levels = NULL,
  group_levels = NULL,
  compare_groups = NULL,
  min_cell = 10,
  p_adjust_method = "BH",
  Verbose = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    res_phase

    A data.frame returned by infer_cell_phase(). It must contain "cell" and the column specified by theta_by.

    metadata

    A data.frame containing cell-level metadata.

    celltype_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in metadata used as the cell-type annotation. Defaults to "celltype".

    group_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in metadata used as the group or condition annotation. Defaults to "condition".

    sample_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in metadata used as the sample annotation. If NULL, only group-level rho is computed. Defaults to NULL.

    theta_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in res_phase containing inferred cell phase in radians. Defaults to "theta_pred".

    celltype_levels

    A character vector specifying the order of cell types. If NULL, levels are sorted automatically. Defaults to NULL.

    group_levels

    A character vector specifying the order of groups. If NULL, levels are sorted automatically. Defaults to NULL.

    compare_groups

    A character vector of length two specifying two groups to compare in sample-level rho tests. If NULL, the first two group levels are used. Defaults to NULL.

    min_cell

    A numeric value specifying the minimum number of cells required for each rho estimate. Defaults to 10.

    p_adjust_method

    A character vector specifying the multiple-testing correction method passed to p.adjust. Defaults to "BH".

    Verbose

    A logical value indicating whether progress messages should be printed. Defaults to FALSE.

    Value

    An object of class scRhythmPhaseRho, containing:

    data

    Cleaned cell-level phase and metadata table.

    rho_result

    Group-level rho estimates for each cell type and group.

    rho_sample

    Sample-level rho estimates, returned only when sample_by is provided.

    rho_sample_summary

    Sample-level rho summary by cell type and group, returned only when sample_by is provided.

    sig_result

    Sample-level group-comparison results, returned only when sample_by is provided and comparison groups are available.

    params

    Parameters used for rho summarization.

    Details

    Cells are matched between res_phase and metadata by the cell column.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("srb_example_data")

res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

rho_res <- run_phase_rho(
  res_phase = res_phase,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  celltype_by = "celltype",
  group_by = "condition",
  group_levels = c("A", "B"),
  min_cell = 10,
  Verbose = TRUE
)

rho_res
head(rho_res$rho_result)
} # }
